text:
alex (eng): Hey team, FYI my Jan/Feb paystubs still show US federal/state withholding only. I relocated to Ireland on 2025-01-15 and submitted the move kit + passport copy on 2025-01-12. Expected PAYE/PRSI to apply. Can someone confirm receipt?

tina (people-ops): Thanks @alex. Can you drop your employee ID and the folder path where you uploaded docs? Ill escalate to payroll.

alex (eng): Employee ID 9073. Uploaded to relocations/alex-ireland on 2025-01-12. Screenshot of paystub snippet:```
Pay Date: 2025-02-28
Gross Pay: $8,400.00
Federal: $1,680.00
State: $0.00
Foreign Withholding: $0.00
Net: $6,720.00
Notes: No Irish deductions recorded
```

rafael (global-payroll): Hi @tina / @alex, Rafael from Global Payroll here. It looks like the residency flag did not sync from the relocation system to payroll provider for Jan/Feb. Ive opened ticket GP-6842 to update residency effective 2025-01-15 and run a retro calculation for Jan/Feb. Well need Alex's PPSN when available to finalize PAYE. Temporary PPSN placeholder is possible to allow withholding profile change.

payroll-bot: Ticket GP-6842 created by rafael (global-payroll) "International residency sync failure: alex (9073)". Priority: P2. Expect initial reply within 1 business day.

ivy (eng): I had a similar move last year. Payroll applied Irish deductions mid-cycle and then posted a separate "retro adjustment" line the following payrun. Nothing long-term broken but check for a small net shortfall.

rafael (global-payroll): Next steps for Alex: 1) confirm PPSN or agree to temporary placeholder, 2) confirm exact move-in date (alex: 2025-01-15), 3) well request retro figures and advise whether additional withholding or credit is due. Also confirming whether a corrected US W-2 or explanatory statement will be necessary for 2025 reporting. Well update GP-6842 with advisor guidance.

tina (people-ops): @rafael can you also confirm impact on benefits withholding (health/dental premiums) and any action needed on our side to change benefit payroll codes for Ireland? We have a couple of contractors with international benefit elections and want to ensure consistency.

rafael (global-payroll): Good point. Irish payroll codes differ; benefits deductions may need remapping. Ive added that as an action in GP-6842. If premiums were taken in USD on US payroll, well either adjust credits or switch deduction mapping going forward.

alex (eng): PPSN application in progress (submitted 2025-01-20). Please keep me posted. Happy to provide any docs.

payroll-bot: GP-6842 status: "Awaiting retro calculation". Last updated 1753160000.

rafael (global-payroll): Update: Retro calc estimate should be ready by next payroll cycle. If there is a withholding shortfall it will appear as a single adjustment line. For W-2 implications: our tax counsel says usually no amended W-2 unless year-to-date amounts materially change; instead we can provide an explanatory letter and include adjustments on final paystubs. Ill confirm once tax counsel signs off.

alex (eng): Thanks all. Please ping here when GP-6842 shows final numbers. Leaving Slack open.

(global note): thread created 1753159999, last update 1753163600
